appDescription: Find the best home for your next article: open access deals, publication statistics, and journal information.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.pathLine: Journal pages live at {path}. Search for the journal by title, ISSN, or topic from your institution's search page.

footer.dataSources: Data: OpenAlex, the cOAlition S Journal Checker Tool, openaccess.nl, OpenAPC, Scimago, and the Jisc Open Policy Finder. Links on every page lead to the upstream source.

yearFilter.presetHint: Limit publication counts, lists, and charts to these years. The choice is saved per university.

badges.oaTypeGoldTitle: Gold open access. Every article is published open access on the journal's own site.
badges.oaTypeDiamondTitle: Diamond open access. The journal is fully open access and charges no fees for readers or authors.
badges.oaTypeGenericTitle: Open access journal. The exact model (gold or diamond) could not be determined from the sources.
badges.oaTypeHybridTitle: Hybrid journal. A subscription journal where individual articles can be made open access, often through an open access deal.
badges.oaTypeSubscriptionTitle: Subscription journal. Reading the published version requires a subscription.
badges.statusClosedTitle: Closed. No openly accessible version of this publication was found.
badges.statusGreenTitle: Green open access. An author copy of this publication is freely available in a repository.
badges.statusBronzeTitle: Bronze open access. Free to read on the publisher's site, without an explicit open license.
badges.statusPureTitle: Pure holds a freely readable file. Without a DOI we cannot tell the venue's open access model.
badges.pureMatchOtherRecordTitle: A Pure record with this DOI exists, but this page does not link to it. Examples are a book that the page leaves out, or a record not linked to this author.
badges.pureMatchParentBookTitle: The parent book of this chapter has a Pure record.
badges.pureMatchSameTitleTitle: A Pure record with the same title shares an author. It is probably another version or DOI of the same publication.
badges.dealCoveredTitle: Open access deal. APCs for corresponding authors are covered, fully or partly, by an institutional agreement.
badges.dealCappedTitle: Open access deal. The publisher's article cap for this contract year is used up, so free open access publishing is no longer guaranteed.
badges.quartileTitle: Journal impact quartile in its subject category. Q1 means the top 25%. This journal: {quartile}.

facets.hintVenueType: What kind of venue this is: a journal, a book series, conference proceedings, and so on. One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintOpenAccess: Is the journal open access as a whole, for any OA type? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintOaType: How the journal makes content open access. You can combine several types; click a selected type to remove it.
facets.hintDoaj: Is the journal listed in DOAJ, the quality-controlled open access directory? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintQuartile: SCImago impact quartile of the journal in its subject category. One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintApc: Is any APC known for this journal: a list price from OpenAlex, or costs reported to OpenAPC? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintGreenOa: Which versions of an article the publisher lets authors self-archive, according to the Jisc Open Policy Finder. One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintTopic: OpenAlex topic of the journal's works. One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintPublisher: The journal's publisher. One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintDeal: Does an open access deal with {name} cover APCs in this journal? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintInstWorks: Has {name} published in this journal? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.hintInstWorksSince: Has {name} published in this journal since {windowStart}? One choice; click it again to clear.
facets.titleVenueTypeBookSeries: A book series, for example Springer's Lecture Notes. Articles appear as book chapters, not journal issues.
facets.titleVenueTypeConference: Conference proceedings published as their own venue.
facets.titleVenueTypeEbookPlatform: A platform hosting e-books, as classified by OpenAlex.
facets.titleVenueTypeRepository: An institutional or subject repository, as classified by OpenAlex.
facets.titleOaYes: The journal is fully or partly open access.
facets.titleOaNo: A subscription journal with no open access.
facets.titleOaTypeGold: Every article is published open access on the journal's own site.
facets.titleOaTypeDiamond: A fully open access journal without fees for readers or authors.
facets.titleOaTypeHybrid: A subscription journal where individual articles can be made open access.
facets.titleOaTypeGeneric: An open access journal whose business model could not be determined. It is open access, but no source shows whether it charges authors.
facets.titleOaTypeSubscription: No open access. Reading the published version requires a subscription.
facets.titleDoajYes: Listed in DOAJ, the Directory of Open Access Journals, a quality-controlled registry for open access journals.
facets.titleDoajNo: Not listed in DOAJ. Hybrid and subscription journals usually are not.
facets.titleQuartileQ1: Top 25% of its SCImago subject category by citation metrics.
facets.titleQuartileQ2: Second quarter, 25 to 50%, of its SCImago subject category.
facets.titleQuartileQ3: Third quarter, 50 to 75%, of its SCImago subject category.
facets.titleQuartileQ4: Last quarter, past 75%, of its SCImago subject category by citation metrics.
facets.titleApcKnown: APCs are known for this journal: a list price from OpenAlex, or costs reported to OpenAPC.
facets.titleApcUnknown: No APC is known for this journal from either source.
facets.titleGreenOaSubmitted: You may self-archive the submitted version (preprint), for example on a preprint server or your own website.
facets.titleGreenOaAccepted: You may self-archive the peer-reviewed accepted version (postprint), for example in an institutional repository.
facets.titleGreenOaPublished: You may self-archive the publisher's final published version.
facets.titleGreenOaNone: The journal is listed by the Jisc Open Policy Finder, but it permits no self-archiving route or prohibits open access outright.
facets.titleDealCovered: APCs for corresponding {short} authors are covered, fully or partly, by a deal.
facets.titleInstWorksYes: {name} has at least one publication in this journal.
facets.titleInstWorksYesSince: {name} has at least one publication in this journal since {windowStart}.
facets.titleInstWorksNo: {name} has no known publications in this journal.
facets.titleInstWorksNoSince: {name} has no known publications in this journal since {windowStart}.

trend.noWorks: No works recorded for this period.
trend.chartLabel: Open access status of {short} publications per year
trend.bronzeNote: Bronze means that the article is free to read on the publisher's site without an explicit open license. It is open access, but free sharing is not guaranteed.

funder.inputLabel: Select your funder to see policy fit
funder.worksTitle: {count, plural, one {# work from this institution credits this funder} other {# works from this institution credit this funder}}

sortHead.sortedAscReverse: Sorted A to Z, low to high. Click to reverse.
sortHead.sortedAscReset: Sorted A to Z, low to high. Click to reset.
sortHead.sortedDescReverse: Sorted Z to A, high to low. Click to reverse.
sortHead.sortedDescReset: Sorted Z to A, high to low. Click to reset.

feedback.success: Thanks. Your report is in, including the page data.
feedback.descriptionPlaceholder: What did you see, and what did you expect? *
feedback.privacyNote: The current URL and the data shown on this page are included automatically.
feedback.error: Something went wrong while sending the report. Try again.

errors.badRequest: The request was not valid. Adjust the filters and try again.
errors.notFound: We could not find that information. Check the address, or go back and adjust your search.
errors.server: The server could not process the search. Try again in a moment.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while loading this data. Try again in a moment.
